MotoGP Mandalika ‌2025: Your Guide to Experiencing the Thrill Motorsports fans, rejoice! The roar‍ of engines and the smell of burning rubber ⁣are coming to ⁤Mandalika,⁤ Indonesia , onc again. MotoGP Mandalika 2025 , scheduled for October 3-5 , 2025, promises to be‌ an unforgettable spectacle, offering fans a chance to witness the ⁢world’s fastest riders compete on the stunning ⁤Indonesian circuit. ⁢
Tickets for‍ this highly anticipated event ⁤went ​on sale February 8, 2025, with early bird discounts available exclusively‍ through www.themandalikagp.com.
“As part of the Early Bird program,‍ we are giving the biggest discount for customers who buy early.The amount of this discount will continue to decrease over time,” stated the official announcement.
This⁤ year, fans have a wider range‍ of options to choose from, including the exciting addition of VIP ⁢Luxury Tents. These luxurious accommodations, strategically located in Zones⁢ T1, D, F, and G, provide unparalleled comfort and exclusivity. Imagine enjoying the race from plush seating, relaxing⁢ in ​spacious areas, and indulging⁤ in premium ‍food and beverage services.
Here’s a breakdown ‍of the ticket prices:
Regular Grandstand (Zones E, G, H, and ​I): Rp140,000
Premium Grandstand (zones B, C, J, and ​K): Rp315,000
Premium Grandstand (Zone A): Rp612,500
VIP Luxury Tent (Zones T1, D, F, and G): Rp5,812,500
VIP Deluxe Class: Rp11,250,000
According ⁣to ITDC President‌ Director Ari Respati, “Through this ⁤Early Bird program, MotoGP fans can get ‍tickets at a more economical price and ensure the best experiance in watching the‌ action of world-class racers in mandalika. Various ticket categories will be available, providing versatility for viewers in choosing​ the viewing experience that best suits their preferences.”
Beyond ‍the Race: mandalika’s Growing Appeal Mandalika,located on‍ Lombok Island,is rapidly becoming a premier destination for tourism and entertainment. ⁣Its stunning beaches, lush landscapes,‌ and vibrant culture attract visitors ⁢from around the globe.
hosting MotoGP Mandalika 2025 further⁤ solidifies Mandalika’s position as a global hub, showcasing Indonesia’s potential to host major international​ events.

MotoGP Mandalika 2025: an ‍Interview with a Motorsports Enthusiast Time.news Editor: with motogp‌ Mandalika 2025 just around the corner,we spoke⁣ with a passionate motorsport fan about the upcoming event.

Would you say that attending MotoGP mandalika 2025 is a must-do experience?
